releases.title: Everkind Announces Closing of Private Placement of Subscription Receipts
releases.summary: Everkind closed a non-brokered private placement through the issuance of 7,625,000 subscription receipts at a price of $0.80 per Subscription Receipt for aggregate gross proceeds of $6,100,000.

releases.title: Everkind Expands First Responder Support Through Strategic Agreement with Brampton Fire and Emergency Services
releases.summary: A Platform Services Agreement making Everkind's AI wellness platform available to all Brampton Fire and Emergency Services personnel and their eligible family members as a wellness benefit.

releases.title: Everkind and Connected Care Announce Strategic Partnership to Bring AI-Powered Mental Wellness to Canadian Youth and Athletes
releases.summary: A Platform Services Agreement integrating Everkind's AI wellness platform into Connected Care's service offering for its existing client base of athletes across Canada.

releases.title: Everkind Engages Conformance AI to Strengthen Independent AI Safety and Quality Oversight
releases.summary: A partnership with Conformance AI, a team of independent experts in AI quality and safety, to evaluate and monitor how Everkind's AI products support users.

releases.title: Everkind, An AI-Powered Life Coach, Announces Closing of $3,000,000 Financing and the Formation of the Everkind Foundation
releases.summary: Everkind raised an additional $3 million and announced the formation of the Everkind Foundation.

releases.title: EverKind, an AI-Powered Life Coach, Announces Financing, Unlocking the Next Era of Social Wellness
releases.summary: EverKind announced it has officially raised approximately $1.8 million to advance its mission of redefining emotional wellness support.

releases.title: EverKind Appoints Nagar Rahmani to Board of Directors
releases.summary: Nagar Rahmani joins EverKind's Board of Directors.

releases.title: EverKind, an AI-Powered Life Coach, Announces the Appointment of Former Toronto Police Chief Mark Saunders to Its Board of Directors
releases.summary: Former Toronto Police Chief Mark Saunders is appointed to EverKind's Board of Directors.
